name: The Cathedral of the Black Benediction

rooms.name: Front Steps
rooms.description: Broad stone steps climb to the cathedral doors beneath rain-blackened saints with chipped faces. The air smells of wet stone, old incense, and candle smoke leaking from within.

rooms.name: Narthex
rooms.description: The entry hall is cold and narrow, with soot-stained walls and candle stubs guttering in red glass cups. Heavy inner doors stand ahead, their iron hinges shaped like thorned vines.

rooms.name: Nave
rooms.description: The great central hall rises into ribbed darkness, where vaulted arches vanish above rows of abandoned pews. A long carpet of shadow points toward the distant altar, broken by thin shafts of gray light through stained glass.

rooms.name: North Side Aisle
rooms.description: This side passage runs beneath tall windows of violet and green glass, their saints warped into grim silhouettes. The stone here is colder, and old wax pools along the wall like frozen tears.

rooms.name: South Side Aisle
rooms.description: A parallel aisle stretches through stale incense haze, lined with cracked plaques and narrow arched doors. The faint sound of dripping water echoes from somewhere nearby.

rooms.name: Confessional Room
rooms.description: The small chamber is close and airless, its wooden walls smelling of dust, mildew, and old varnish. A latticed booth waits in the gloom, its curtain hanging like a strip of funeral cloth.

rooms.name: Baptistry
rooms.description: The baptistry is tiled in faded blue and white, but the basin at its center holds water as black as ink. Moisture beads on the walls despite the chill, and every sound returns as a hollow ripple.

rooms.name: Side Chapel
rooms.description: A smaller chapel opens beneath a low arch, its devotional candles burned down to knotted black lumps. A side altar bears clawed grooves across its cloth as if something dragged itself across the stone.

rooms.name: Storage Room
rooms.description: This cramped room is packed with candle boxes, broken frames, and folded funeral cloths. The smell of dust is sharp enough to taste, undercut by a sour animal musk.

rooms.name: North Transept
rooms.description: The north arm of the cathedral is dominated by a huge stained-glass window showing a black sun above kneeling figures. Its colored light lies on the floor like bruises.

rooms.name: South Transept
rooms.description: The south arm is quieter, lined with memorial plaques whose names have been scratched away. A service door and a smaller inner door sit beneath the watching faces of carved angels.

rooms.name: Choir
rooms.description: Carved choir stalls face each other beneath suspended iron lamps, their seats polished by generations of vanished singers. A faint vibration clings to the air, like the last note of a hymn that never ended.

rooms.name: Sanctuary
rooms.description: The sanctuary rises on shallow steps behind an altar rail, its candles burning with low blue flames. The main altar is draped in black cloth, and the stone beneath it is stained in the shape of outspread wings.

rooms.name: Vesting Room
rooms.description: Hooks and racks crowd the walls, bearing vestments gone stiff with dust and damp. The room smells of camphor, old wool, and something faintly metallic.

rooms.name: Records Room
rooms.description: Shelves of ledgers and parish books lean against the walls, their labels yellowed and curling. A thin draft turns loose pages with the dry whisper of insects.

rooms.name: Office
rooms.description: This private office is neat in the way of a room abandoned in haste, with a chair pushed back from the desk and drawers left slightly open. Rain taps softly against the narrow window.

rooms.name: Bell Tower Stair
rooms.description: A tight spiral stair coils upward inside the tower wall, its stones worn concave by centuries of feet. Cold air sighs down the shaft, carrying the faint taste of rust.

rooms.name: Bell Tower
rooms.description: The bell chamber is open to the night through tall louvered arches, and wind moves through it with a low moan. The great bronze bell hangs overhead, green with age and marked by a long black crack.

rooms.name: Service Door
rooms.description: A narrow service vestibule leads to a warped outer door barred with iron. Wet air seeps through the frame, carrying the smell of grave soil and weeds.

rooms.name: Crypt Stair
rooms.description: Stone steps descend from behind the sanctuary into a damp throat of darkness. The walls narrow as they fall, and the air grows heavy with the mineral smell of sealed graves.

rooms.name: Crypt
rooms.description: The crypt lies beneath low arches, crowded with stone coffins and wall niches sealed by cracked nameplates. At the far end, a black altar has been built from broken grave slabs, its candles burning without heat.

statBlock.name: Crawling Claw
statBlock.appearance: A severed human hand with gray, waxy skin and blackened fingernails. A tarnished rosary is wrapped tightly around its wrist stump.

entities.name: silver confession token hidden behind the booth panel

statBlock.name: Skeleton
statBlock.appearance: A yellowed human skeleton in the remains of a church server's robe. Its eye sockets glow faintly red, and a rusted shortsword hangs from one bony hand.

entities.name: small silver saint medallion beneath the altar cloth
silver altar knife wrapped in black cloth
hidden ward at the altar rail that rings a silent bell in the crypt and chills living flesh
silver bell clapper fragment caught in the rafters
rusted trip chain stretched ankle-high across the lower stairs

statBlock.name: Father Malrec, Black Acolyte
statBlock.appearance: A pale, hollow-eyed human priest in a tattered black cassock stitched with silver thread. A bone-handled dagger hangs from one hand, and soot-black veins crawl up the neck.

entities.name: stolen silver reliquary under the black altar

goals: Recover the stolen silver reliquary from the crypt
End the black benediction corrupting the main altar
Find the bishop's sealed confession in the records room
